nights.name: THE CLASSIC
nights.line: The original. Everything you came for.

nights.name: THE MIDAS HEIST
nights.line: AJKR cracked the vault. Everything is gold.

nights.name: COSMIC TAKEOVER
nights.line: The house has left the planet.

nights.name: BRAINROT APOCALYPSE
nights.line: The memes have escaped. Nobody is safe.

nights.name: HOT HOT DISCO
nights.line: The dance floor is on fire. Keep dancing.

nights.name: FROSTBITE FRENZY
nights.line: Winter came early. And it brought friends.

nights.name: CANDY CHAOS
nights.line: Too much sugar. Way too much.

nights.name: NEON OVERDRIVE
nights.line: Every light in the house turned up to eleven.

nights.name: THE DEEP DIVE
nights.line: The house sank. The party didn't.

nights.name: THUNDER PALACE
nights.line: Two storms walk into a house.

nights.name: METEOR MADNESS
nights.line: Look up. No, really, look up.

nights.name: THE SINGULARITY
nights.line: Gravity is optional tonight.

nights.name: ALIEN INVASION
nights.line: They came in peace. Mostly.

nights.name: THE ROYAL BALL
nights.line: Dress code: fabulous. Gravity: optional.

nights.name: ABOVE THE CLOUDS
nights.line: The house is floating above the clouds.

nights.name: JUNGLE RUMBLE
nights.line: Vines in the ballroom. Something is drumming.

nights.name: THE PHARAOH'S GOLD
nights.line: The sands have shifted. The gold is real.

nights.name: CHERRY BLOSSOM NIGHT
nights.line: Soft, pink, and a little bit magical.

nights.name: RETROWAVE '86
nights.line: Pink sun. Chrome everything. Maximum volume.

nights.name: THE GLITCH
nights.line: Something is wrong with the house. Everything is wrong. It's great.

nights.name: ROCKET NIGHT
nights.line: 3, 2, 1... everybody up.

nights.name: ZERO GRAVITY GALA
nights.line: A black-tie dinner. In orbit.

nights.name: THE CONFETTI CANNONADE
nights.line: We bought too much confetti. All of it goes tonight.

nights.name: TITAN SHOWDOWN
nights.line: Two giant memes. One house. Pick a side.

nights.name: LIGHTS OUT PARTY
nights.line: Who turned the lights off? (We did.)

nights.name: MIDNIGHT AGENT
nights.line: Your mission tonight: total chaos.

nights.name: TORNADO ALLEY
nights.line: Hold on to something. Anything.

nights.name: GOLD RUSH HOUR
nights.line: Gold in the hallways. Gold on the stairs. Grab it.

nights.name: FIRE & ICE
nights.line: Half the house is burning. The other half is frozen.

nights.name: BUBBLE MANIA
nights.line: Pop them all. There are millions.

nights.name: RAINBOW RIOT
nights.line: Every colour. All at once. On purpose.

nights.name: RISE OF THE MEME LORDS
nights.line: The memes have taken over the house. They seem nice.

nights.name: SUPERNOVA
nights.line: A star is about to go off. Front row seats.

nights.name: END OF THE WORLD PARTY
nights.line: If it's the end, we're ending it dancing.

nights.name: GALAXY BRAIN
nights.line: Big thoughts. Bigger effects.

nights.name: THE WIZARD'S TOWER
nights.line: Somebody read the spellbook out loud.

nights.name: KING OF THE HOUSE
nights.line: AJKR, standing over the house. Bow.

nights.name: AJKR'S ARMY
nights.line: One AJKR wasn't enough.

nights.name: THE COLOSSUS RISES
nights.line: Something enormous is standing behind the house.

nights.name: ARCADE MODE
nights.line: Insert coin. Actually, it's free. Go.

nights.name: STORM CHASERS
nights.line: Breaking: every weather, at once, indoors.

nights.name: THE GREEN ROOM
nights.line: Backstage, everything is green and lucky.

nights.name: THE VIP LOUNGE
nights.line: Velvet ropes, gold lights. Everybody's on the list.

nights.name: CARNIVAL NIGHT
nights.line: Step right up! Everything spins!

nights.name: HYPERDRIVE
nights.line: Punch it.

nights.name: VOLCANO NIGHT
nights.line: The floor is lava. (It isn't. Keep sorting.)

nights.name: THE SNOW GLOBE
nights.line: Someone picked up the house and shook it.

nights.name: DREAMLAND
nights.line: You fell asleep at the table. This is the dream.

nights.name: THE FINAL BOSS
nights.line: BOSS INCOMING. It's a meme. It's enormous.

nights.name: THE HACK
nights.line: AJKR typed one command. The house did the rest.

nights.name: THE GOLDEN AGE
nights.line: The house at its most magnificent.

nights.name: CHAOS THEORY
nights.line: No plan. No order. Everything.

nights.name: MIDNIGHT MASQUERADE
nights.line: Masks on. Lights low. Music loud.

nights.name: PALM BEACH NIGHTS
nights.line: Pool party. In a mansion. At midnight.

nights.name: WILD WEST SHOWDOWN
nights.line: This house ain't big enough for all these effects.

commands.label: 🚀 Rocket launch ON
commands.line: Every guest shoots into the sky. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 💃 Dance party ON
commands.line: Every guest dances, under disco light. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.line: Thunder and lightning over the house. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🗿 Brainrot storm ON
commands.line: Memes pour from the sky round every guest. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🎉 Confetti cannons ON
commands.line: Cannons of confetti round every guest. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 💥 Shockwave ON
commands.line: A golden blast from you throws every guest near you back. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🌀 Spin ON
commands.line: Every guest spins like a top. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: ☄️ Meteor shower ON
commands.line: Blazing meteors streak down and slam round every guest. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🕳️ Black hole ON

commands.label: 🌌 Aurora ON

commands.label: 🪐 Galaxy sky ON
commands.line: The sky turns to deep space: stars, nebulae and a ringed planet. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🛸 UFO abduction ON
commands.line: A flying saucer hovers over each guest and beams them up. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🌨️ Blizzard ON

commands.label: 🌋 Earthquake ON

commands.label: 🌈 Rainbow mode ON
commands.line: Everything turns every colour at once, with rainbow trails. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🧼 Bubble party ON
commands.line: Thousands of bubbles float up round every guest. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🌊 Gold wave ON
commands.line: A tidal wave of gold coins washes over every screen. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🔥 Fire & Ice ON
commands.line: Embers and snowflakes, red and blue, at once. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🔦 Blackout ON
commands.line: The lights go out; spotlights sweep the dark, then everything blazes back. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🌪️ Tornado ON
commands.line: A whirlwind spins up beside every guest and carries them round. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🎆 Fireworks finale ON
commands.line: The sky fills with fireworks over every guest. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🗿 Titan meme ON
commands.line: A colossal meme rises over the rooftops, looks round, and sinks. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🌙 Zero gravity ON
commands.line: Everyone floats, slowly, then drifts back down. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🕺 The owner's army ON
commands.line: A crowd of the owner drops from the sky and dances round every guest. Stays on until it's switched off.

commands.label: 🧹 Every effect OFF
commands.line: Every effect switched off, in every server.
